## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Related issue

Link the issue or explain why this change does not need one.

## User-visible behavior

Describe what users will observe, including accepted limitations or compatibility changes. Write `None` for internal-only changes.

## Validation

List the exact commands and manual scenarios run.

## Security and privacy

Describe effects on telemetry content, storage, network access, IPC, MCP, dependencies, packaging, or release artifacts. Write `None` when there is no effect.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows existing package boundaries.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or regressions.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] User-visible behavior was verified through the relevant `docs/test.md` scenarios.
- [ ] Affected documentation was updated in the same change.
- [ ] No credentials, private telemetry, generated output, or local machine paths were added.
